paragraphs: R' Yonah bar Tzadiyah. See the entry R' Yonah Butzriyah.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied forms are צדייה, Tzadiyah, and בוצרייה, Butzriyah; their vocalizations remain provisional. An earlier heading audit had צדירה. The heading and original entry boundary were recorded as uncertain, and no source correction is made here. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
